title: Last.fm listen detection and your listening diary
summary: Connect Last.fm and Rescened can spot when you’ve listened to a full album, then help you keep a diary of what you’ve heard.
changes: Connect Last.fm from the new tab on your profile. It’s rolling out to a small group first.
An album counts as listened once you play at least 80% of its standard tracks.
Log a detected listen to your diary or dismiss it, or turn on automatic logging.
Automatically logged entries are labeled, and you can change their date or delete them.

title: A home for what’s new
summary: Follow along as Rescened grows. Patch notes bring new features, improvements, and fixes together in one place.
changes: Open Patch notes from the navigation bar, whether you’re signed in or just browsing.
Read the latest updates first, with earlier releases kept here to explore.
